errors.evidence: The y-axis range is not 0-100 for all plots. For the MATH-500 plots (a, b, c), the range is 65-100. For the AIME24 plots (d, e, f), the range is 0-90.
The description claims that DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (95.2%) exceeds DeepSeek-R1 (97.3%), which is incorrect. 95.2 is less than 97.3.
The description claims that DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (63.3%) matches o1-mini (63.6%). While the values are very close, they are not an exact match.

errors.text_span: consistently achieving higher scores than their larger CoT counterparts
errors.evidence: This claim is an over-generalization. While TTS models outperform CoT models in several subplots, there are exceptions. In subplot (c), the CoT model DeepSeek-R1 (97.3%) outperforms the TTS model DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (95.2%). In subplot (e), the CoT model o1-mini (63.6%) slightly outperforms the TTS model DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (63.3%).
